turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Here is one example, step by step.
Word: "ant". First sound: "a", a vowel sound. So I write: I see an ant.
The rule: an goes before a vowel sound; a goes before other sounds.
Right: I see a bus. Wrong: I see an bus.

Now try this one. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
